unit: Workspace history admission and ordered persistence
failuresRetained: Initial QA save rejected because the PostgreSQL adapter serialized a JSON-null parameter as SQL NULL. The placeholder now uses a constant JSON null literal.
A valid redo selection was initially rejected against the current report widget enum. Its exact widget reference is now checked against the historical page; other schema failures remain failures.
limitations: Native browser QA used a synthetic isolated workspace. Hosted qualification is separate.
Historical report normalization is not silently accepted; any differing current state or stack entry holds saving.
